title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Senior Product Manager - Remote (EU)
Must have: Agile, A/B Testing, User Stories, Roadmapping, User Research, KPI Definition
Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience
Good to have: Scrum, Product Analytics, Product Strategy, Market Research
Tasks: Work daily with engineering, design and stakeholders; Define success metrics and track outcomes; Own the roadmap and backlog for a product area
